step1_analysis.circuit_type: Fully Differential Telescopic Cascode Operational Amplifier
step1_analysis.description: This circuit is a fully differential telescopic cascode op-amp with NMOS source followers at the input. The source followers shift the DC level to accommodate the input common-mode, while the telescopic cascode structure provides high voltage gain and output impedance.

paper_reference.title: A 10-b 120-Msample/s Time-Interleaved Analog-to-Digital Converter With Digital Background Calibration

DC Gain.description: Low-frequency differential voltage gain of the op-amp.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm3 * Rout, where Rout is the parallel combination of the NMOS and PMOS cascode output impedances.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Telescopic cascodes typically achieve 50-60 dB gain in 130nm processes due to the high output impedance of the cascode stages.

Unity Gain Bandwidth (UGBW).description: The frequency at which the open-loop differential voltage gain drops to 0 dB (1 V/V).

sky130_expected.calculation: UGBW = gm3 / (2 * pi * Cload). Assuming gm3 ~ 1mA/V and Cload = 1pF.
sky130_expected.reasoning: For a 120-MS/s ADC, the op-amp UGBW needs to be several times higher than the sampling frequency to ensure proper settling.

Phase Margin.description: Phase difference from -180 degrees at the unity gain frequency, indicating stability.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the non-dominant poles (e.g., at the cascode nodes N5/N6).
sky130_expected.reasoning: A phase margin of >60 degrees is required for stable closed-loop operation without excessive ringing.

Power Consumption.description: Total static power dissipated by the op-amp from the supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: Power = VDD * I_total. I_total includes the tail current and the two source follower bias currents.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A single op-amp in a pipeline/time-interleaved ADC typically consumes a few milliwatts.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC gain, UGBW, phase margin, and power consumption of the fully differential telescopic cascode op-amp.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Fully Differential Telescopic Cascode Op-Amp Testbench
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u

XM1 VDD VIP N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 VDD VIN N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N5 N3 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N6 N4 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 VON VB3 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 VOP VB3 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 VON VB2 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 VOP VB2 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N1 VB1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N2 VB1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N3 VB5 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N7 VB5 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N7 VCMFB GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 N4 VB5 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVIP VIP 0 DC 0.9 AC 0.5 SIN(0.9 0.1 10MEG)
VVIN VIN 0 DC 0.9 AC -0.5 SIN(0.9 -0.1 10MEG)

VVB3 VB3 0 0.54
VVB2 VB2 0 0.99
VVB1 VB1 0 0.99
VVB5 VB5 0 0.54

* Ideal CMFB to hold output common-mode at 0.9V
Bcmfb VCMFB 0 V='0.9 + (V(VOP)+V(VON)-1.8)*10'

* Load capacitance
CL1 VOP 0 1p
CL2 VON 0 1p

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

ac dec 100 1k 10G
let vdiff = v(VOP) - v(VON)
let gain_db = vdb(vdiff)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(vdiff)

meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1k
meas ac ugbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac phase_at_ugbw find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1
let pm = 180 + phase_at_ugbw
print pm

tran 100p 200n
let vdiff_tran = v(VOP) - v(VON)
meas tran vdiff_max max vdiff_tran
meas tran vdiff_min min vdiff_tran
.endc
.end
